question:
Which of the following options is most similar in meaning to the given word?

Laudable
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2'** i.e. **'Praiseworthy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "Laudable"** in English means deserving praise or commendation (प्रशंसनीय).

 
 
• **Example:** The team's laudable effort in the charity run won them much admiration and respect.
 
 
 
• The word** "Praiseworthy"** is similar in meaning to "Laudable". It refers to something that deserves approval and admiration (प्रशंसनीय).
 
 
• **Example:** The student's praiseworthy performance in the exam was appreciated by all the professors.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is -** 'Praiseworthy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Preventable'** (Option 1) refers to something that can be stopped from happening or avoided (रोकने योग्य).
 
• **'Sensible'** (Option 3) can describe someone or something that shows good judgment, practicality, or wisdom. (समझदार).
 
• **'Returnable' **(Option 4) refers to something that can be given back or refunded, often used in commerce (वापस लाये जा सकने योग्य).
